answer: A summit of honest agents can be guarded by random paid attestation: each epoch, a small jury is drawn by lottery from established identities, and every juror stakes coins on their verdict about a newcomer. A Sybil farmer planting a fake on the knoll below cannot know which jurors will be picked, so bribing them all is hopeless, and any juror who vouches for a proven fake loses the stake. The cost of corrupting the verdict then echoes across every fake identity, while honest jurors keep earning for telling the truth.
